field_principles.field_principles: Each required value states why it is needed for later audits.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact source checks prevent reduction of changed evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration proves this process performs no model inference.
field_principles.duration_s: A local monotonic interval proves the reducer itself ran.
field_principles.source_live_duration_s: A separate source-derived interval prevents duration aliasing.
field_principles.source_live_duration_derivation: The formula makes every source-time contribution replayable.
field_principles.duration_alias_detected: The original equality remains visible instead of being erased.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Content hashes bind this receipt to immutable source bytes.
field_principles.source_flag_preservation: Source quarantine and verdict evidence must survive reduction.
field_principles.rows: Per-cell and per-check rows prevent favorable outcomes from hiding failures.
field_principles.cell_identity_rows: Exact identities reveal missing, duplicate, or substituted cells.
field_principles.raw_hash_rows: Raw request and response hashes bind parser evidence to bytes.
field_principles.lifecycle_rows: Lifecycle boundaries define source live time without a copied aggregate.
field_principles.timing_rows: Cell intervals expose reversed, negative, or overlapping timing evidence.
field_principles.arm_rows: Arm counts keep each acquisition method in its original denominator.
field_principles.model_rows: Model counts expose family substitution or omission.
field_principles.source_group_rows: Source-group counts preserve the balanced acquisition design.
field_principles.parser_rows: Parser outcomes retain malformed and unsuccessful cells.
field_principles.stop_reason_rows: Stop reasons preserve transport failures and normal completion.
field_principles.timeout_rows: Timeout counts cannot disappear from a favorable headline.
field_principles.truncation_rows: Truncation counts cannot disappear from a favorable headline.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_metrics: Side-by-side values expose stale source aggregates.
field_principles.source_cell_count: The source count fixes the replay denominator.
field_principles.replayed_cell_count: The replay count proves every source cell was processed.
field_principles.duplicate_cell_count: Zero duplicates prevent one cell from receiving repeated credit.
field_principles.source_mutation_count: Zero mutations are required before evidence can be admitted.
field_principles.model_inference_call_count: Zero confirms that the immutable corpus was not reacquired.
field_principles.fresh_adversarial_rows: Current verifier findings remain evidence, not hidden status.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed identifies this deterministic reducer contract.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A stable digest proves replay evidence agrees across processes.
field_principles.clean_relation_corpus_ready_score: Only complete, alias-safe, clean replay opens semantics.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Failed checks retain their expected and observed values.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False prevents a reducer check from becoming semantic authority.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed enum gives downstream tools one terminal classification.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix prevents partial or blocked work from looking complete.
